notes: Tasks group by running (queued/started/running), completed, failed, and cancelled from existing TaskUiState only.
Progress rendering starts from persisted session progress and does not animate from 0 after process recreation or run backwards.
Task detail sheet shows sanitized identifiers and timestamps; payload-like ids are opaque.
Approval UI distinguishes REQUESTED, RESOLVING (local tap in flight), EXPIRED_LOCAL (device clock), and SERVER outcome. Local tap is never authoritative.
Duplicate taps are blocked while resolving or after local expiry. Biometric still required for SENSITIVE/CRITICAL. Non-owners see no approval list.
No Room schema change. contract/webv1 and transport/** were not edited. Phase A5 was not started.
